#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <cstdio>

using namespace std;

int main() {
    int n;
    cin >> n;
    cin.ignore(); // ignore newline after integer
    string s;
    getline(cin, s);
    s += '_';
    s = s.substr(0, n + 1);

    bool inPar = false;
    int wordsInside = 0;
    int maxOutside = 0;
    int pos = 0;

    for (int i = 0; i <= n; ++i) {
        char c = s[i];
        if (c == '(' || c == ')' || c == '_') {
            if (i > pos) {
                int len = i - pos;
                if (inPar) {
                    wordsInside++;
                } else if (len > maxOutside) {
                    maxOutside = len;
                }
            }
            if (c == '(') {
                inPar = true;
            } else if (c == ')') {
                inPar = false;
            }
            pos = i + 1;
        }
    }

    printf("%d %d", maxOutside, wordsInside);
    return 0;
}
